_: The numbers the documents are allowed to quote, and how each was obtained.
This exists because the same mistake happened three times: a figure was
measured, written into twenty documents and a slide deck, and then the code
moved without them. 'how' is the important column — a number nobody can
reproduce is an assertion, not a measurement.
scripts/check-claims.mjs fails the build when a document disagrees with this
file. docs/release/ and docs/verification/ are exempt: they record what was
true for a past build, and correcting them would falsify the record.
measuredAgainst: a database migrated from empty, then seeded (npm run demo:reset)

assertions.how: sum of the six suites below; each printed by its own runner

notExecuted.why: needs a Razorpay sandbox account and refuses to run without one; never counted in the total, never described as passing

otherRunners.why: separate toolchains with their own runners; not part of the six-suite total

how: Count through pg_depend, NEVER bare information_schema.
CREATE EXTENSION postgis installs spatial_ref_sys into public, which
inflated tables, primary keys, indexes and unique indexes by exactly one
each. information_schema.check_constraints emits one row per NOT NULL
column, which is how '433 check constraints' was published when there are 5.
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'
LEFT JOIN pg_depend d ON d.objid = c.oid AND d.deptype = 'e'
WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND d.objid IS NULL;

api.how: 49 in server.ts + 15 in raksha.ts; grep for app.get/post/patch/put/delete

i18n.how: LOCALES in apps/api/src/i18n.ts; res/values-*/ for Android
i18n.caveat: Seven of the eight are machine-translated and NOT native-reviewed. The strings exist; the quality is unverified. Never quote the count without this.
